g.text: A route examples: dark = main; wine = high market / gantry; green = low branch; violet = east / cargo. Exact paths: coordinates.md.
Same scale: all plan panels use X = -48..48, Z = -76..76 WU. Dotted magenta = stacked floors. Dashed pink = zone.
